MOD = 1_000_000_007

def solve():
    n = int(input())
    ways = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(2 * n)]
    tWays = 0
    ways[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        ways[i][0] = ways[i - 1][1] if 1 <= i - 1 < 2 * n else 0
        ways[i][n] = ways[i - 1][n - 1] if n - 1 >= 0 else 0
        for k in range(1, n):
            ways[i][k] = (ways[i - 1][k - 1] + ways[i - 1][k + 1]) % MOD if (k + 1) <= n and (k - 1) >= 0 else 0
        if i % 2 == 1:
            for k in range(0, min(i + 1, 2 * n - i + 1)):
                tWays = (tWays + ways[i][k]) % MOD
    print(tWays)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
